articles.title: Crypto Biz: Bitcoin’s $116M self-custody wake-up call
articles.snippet: A $116 million Bitcoin wallet exploit puts self-custody under scrutiny as ETF inflows rebound, Strategy eyes more BTC and miners chase billions in AI deals.

articles.title: CFTC to join SEC in exploring crypto regulations without CLARITY bill
articles.snippet: The CFTC will hold a meeting for its Innovation Advisory Committee on Aug. 20 to address regulation related to crypto assets, artificial intelligence and prediction markets.

articles.title: Anthropic's AI Agents Started a Virtual War. The Chat Logs Are Unhinged
articles.snippet: In a new red-team study, Claude models deployed self-replicating malware against each other—and the transcripts explain why.

articles.title: 'Inner Thoughts' of Every Major AI Model Exposed in Massive Exploit
articles.snippet: Researchers found every major AI provider encrypts reasoning tokens with a single global key—and exploited it to decode 315,320 hidden thinking blocks from public logs, recovering passwords and live API keys along the way.

articles.title: After Coldcard Was Hacked, $15 Billion in Bitcoin Moved to Safety
articles.snippet: Casa CEO Nick Neuman says the mass Bitcoin migration after the $130M Coldcard exploit proves distributed self-custody is Bitcoin's immune system—not its vulnerability.
